name: Turing take page renders a five-point unipolar scale and advances
description: The Turing assessment's rating questions use a five-point agree-disagree scale (distinct from Solstice's seven-point bipolar scale), and answering advances through them.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Turing take page

Verify the progress indicator reads '1 of 31' and the first question is a statement presented with a five-point numbered answer scale (options numbered 1 through 5), with 'Strongly disagree' at one end and 'Strongly agree' at the other.
Click the number 3 option on the scale to answer the first question
Verify the progress indicator advances to '2 of 31' and a new statement question is displayed.
